# TKVK — Taj Kaushal Vikas Kendra

> Skill training and practical trade testing of Indian workers for employers in the six
> GCC countries. Based in New Friends Colony, New Delhi, India.
> Last reviewed: 2026-10-01

## What TKVK is

TKVK (Taj Kaushal Vikas Kendra) is an Indian skill-training and trade-testing organisation.
It trains Indian tradesmen and tests them practically before they are presented to a Gulf employer.

TKVK is not itself the licensed recruiting agent. Overseas recruitment and deployment are
carried out by **Taj HR Services**, which holds Government of India recruitment licence
**B-3252/DEL/PER/1000+/5/11251/2025**, issued by the Ministry of External Affairs.
Taj HR Services website: https://tajhrservices.com/

Stating it plainly, so the two are not confused:
- TKVK does the training, the practical trade test and the document/PoE preparation.
- Taj HR Services holds the licence and carries out the recruitment and deployment.

## Who TKVK serves

Employers in the GCC: contractors, facility-management companies, industrial and
manufacturing firms, logistics and warehousing operators, hotels and retail groups,
and households hiring domestic staff. The site is written for employers, not job seekers.

## Where TKVK operates

Six Gulf countries only: Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Oman, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain.
No Europe, Canada, Malaysia or any other destination.

## Workforce supplied

TKVK supplies **male workers only**. Where a requirement needs female staff, TKVK says so
at the outset rather than accepting the order.

## How workers are tested

Candidates are assessed on the actual work, not on a certificate:
- a practical task in the candidate's own trade, judged by someone who knows that trade
- evidence (photographs, test results, honest written assessment) sent before the employer interviews
- the employer may run its own test, in person at the New Delhi centre or by video
- installation experience and maintenance experience are reported separately
- what a certificate proves is described exactly; gaps are stated rather than implied

## Documents prepared

Passport and ECR status, approved medical (GAMCA/Wafid), police clearance,
certificate attestation, and eMigrate PoE clearance. Where a destination has its own
checkpoint — for example the Qatar Visa Centre — the file is built to clear it first time.
Local operating licences (for example a Gulf forklift or heavy-equipment licence) are
issued in the destination country and are arranged by the employer; TKVK states this
rather than implying it can issue them from India.

## Trades covered

Welders, electricians, pipe fitters, steel fixers, masons, scaffolders, carpenters, plumbers,
mechanics, HVAC and AC technicians, heavy equipment operators, forklift operators,
heavy drivers, light drivers, delivery riders, security guards, hospitality staff,
cleaning and facility staff, warehouse and logistics staff, packing helpers,
residential building helpers, mall and retail staff, and male household staff
(cooks, houseboys, family drivers, gardeners).

Coverage varies by country. Each trade page states which country it applies to.

## How an employer starts

Send a requirement with the trade, the number of workers, the salary and terms, and the
start date. It reaches info@tkvk.in directly — there is no third-party form service and
nothing is stored on the website.

- Requirement form: https://tkvk.in/send-requirement
- WhatsApp: +91 96513 32002
- Email: info@tkvk.in

## What TKVK does not claim

No guaranteed deployment timelines, no invented certifications, no fabricated client lists,
reviews, statistics or awards. Where an answer is "no" or "we do not know yet", the site
says so. Timelines depend on visa, quota and attestation processes outside TKVK's control.
